question: Consider a rectangular sheet of paper $ABCD$ such that the lengths of $AB$ and $AD$ are respectively 7 and 3 centimetres. Suppose that $B'$ and $D'$ are two points on $AB$ and $AD$ respectively such that if the paper is folded along $B'D'$ then $A$ falls on $A'$ on the side $DC$. Determine the maximum possible area of the triangle $AB'D'$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
